auth.setup_help: Create `.streamlit/secrets.toml` with an `[auth]` section for the Google OAuth client — see the *Login* section of the README. Portfolio features stay locked until then.
auth.no_email: Your identity provider returned no email address, and the app keys all personal data to it. Sign in with an account that shares one.
auth.email_unverified: Your identity provider marked this email address as unverified, and the app keys all personal data to it. Verify the address with your provider, then sign in again.
auth.signin_prompt: Sign in to use this page. Your watchlist, portfolio ledger and preferences are private to your account.
auth.browsing_public: :material/public: Browsing the market pages needs no login.
